l4_steps.name: Receive group travel request via agency or portal
l4_steps.input: Agency/corporate RFQ specifying route, date, pax count, and fare class preference
l4_steps.output: Group Request Record (GRR) with unique reference number
l4_steps.kpi: Request acknowledgement within 4 business hours; ≥95% SLA adherence
l4_steps.pain_point: Group requests arriving via email bypass PSS, creating untracked shadow bookings outside Altéa Groups

l4_steps.name: Qualify group size and policy eligibility
l4_steps.input: GRR with pax count, route, and travel dates
l4_steps.output: Eligibility decision — group qualifies (≥10 pax) or redirected to individual booking
l4_steps.kpi: 100% of groups below policy threshold redirected within 1 business hour
l4_steps.pain_point: Inconsistent group-size thresholds across markets (10 pax domestic vs. 15 pax international) cause misrouting

l4_steps.name: Check flight seat availability for group block
l4_steps.output: Available seat count by fare class; provisional block hold placed
l4_steps.kpi: Seat availability response time <30 seconds; provisional hold valid for 72 hours
l4_steps.pain_point: Provisional holds consume open inventory without commitment, degrading yield; no automated hold expiry in Altéa Groups without manual follow-up

l4_steps.name: Calculate group fare and applicable discount tier
l4_steps.system: ATPCO (Group Fare Rules) + Amadeus Altéa PSS
l4_steps.input: Provisional seat block, travel dates, origin/destination market
l4_steps.output: Group fare proposal with applicable discount tier (e.g. 10%, 15%, 20%)
l4_steps.kpi: Fare calculation accuracy 100%; group fare ≥85% of equivalent published Y/B/M fare
l4_steps.pain_point: ATPCO group fare rule updates (filed twice per IATA season) can invalidate in-progress quotes; agents must manually cross-check effective dates

l4_steps.name: Apply contracted agency or corporate override discount
l4_steps.output: Net group fare with contracted override applied
l4_steps.kpi: Contract compliance rate ≥98%; override correctly applied to all contracted accounts
l4_steps.pain_point: Sabre PRISM contract data can be out of sync with Altéa fare filing if corporate account team updates rates bilaterally outside PRISM

l4_steps.name: Assess yield impact against revenue plan
l4_steps.input: Group fare proposal, seat block size, flight load factor forecast
l4_steps.output: Yield impact assessment — approved / refer / decline
l4_steps.kpi: Group segment revenue contribution ≥ displacement cost; load factor impact <3 pp on high-demand flights
l4_steps.pain_point: NRM displacement cost models use O&D demand curves that may undervalue high-yield late-booking individual traffic displaced by early group blocks

l4_steps.name: Negotiate revised terms if yield threshold not met
l4_steps.output: Revised fare or reduced seat block accepted by agency; or request declined
l4_steps.kpi: Negotiation-to-acceptance rate ≥60% of referred cases; cycle time ≤2 business days
l4_steps.pain_point: No structured counter-offer workflow in Altéa Groups — negotiation conducted off-system via email, losing audit trail

l4_steps.name: Issue formal group quotation to agency
l4_steps.input: Approved fare, seat count, deposit schedule, contract conditions
l4_steps.output: Formal group quote document with 7-day acceptance deadline
l4_steps.kpi: Quote issued within 24 hours of pricing approval; quote acceptance rate ≥70%
l4_steps.pain_point: Quote documents generated outside Altéa as manual PDFs; version control errors lead to agency booking on superseded fare terms

l4_steps.name: Execute group contract and capture deposit obligation
l4_steps.output: Executed group contract with deposit amount and due date logged in PSS
l4_steps.kpi: Contract creation within 4 hours of acceptance; 100% of deposit deadlines captured in PSS
l4_steps.pain_point: Altéa Groups does not send automated deposit due-date reminders to agencies; agents must maintain manual chase calendars

l4_steps.name: Confirm deposit receipt and activate group booking
l4_steps.system: SAP S/4HANA Finance (AR) + Amadeus Altéa PSS
l4_steps.output: Group booking status changed to Confirmed in Altéa; deposit recorded in SAP AR
l4_steps.kpi: Deposit-to-confirmation cycle ≤1 business day; 100% deposit reconciliation with SAP AR
l4_steps.pain_point: BSP/ARC settlement remittance data arrives with 24–48 hour lag, delaying booking confirmation and creating inventory limbo

l4_steps.name: Release unconfirmed seat block if deposit overdue
l4_steps.input: Expired deposit deadline with no payment received
l4_steps.output: Seat block released to open inventory; agency notified
l4_steps.kpi: 100% of overdue blocks released within 2 hours of deadline; zero revenue leakage from zombie holds
l4_steps.pain_point: Manual release process dependent on agent availability; after-hours expirations accumulate until next business day, blocking revenue optimisation

l4_steps.name: Collect passenger name list from agency
l4_steps.input: Agency-submitted passenger name list (CSV or API)
l4_steps.output: Individual PNRs created within group booking; name manifest complete
l4_steps.kpi: PNL submission by T−21 days; name completion rate ≥90% by T−14 days
l4_steps.pain_point: Agencies frequently submit names in non-standard formats requiring manual re-keying into Altéa; APIS-compliant data (passport, DOB) often missing at initial submission

l4_steps.name: Validate name count against contracted seat block
l4_steps.output: Variance report — shortfall or excess names flagged
l4_steps.kpi: Name-count discrepancy <5% of group size; chase cycle completed within 48 hours of deadline
l4_steps.pain_point: Groups with >10% shortfall after T−7 days create difficult trade-off between releasing revenue-generating seats and maintaining client relationship

l4_steps.name: Process name changes within contractual tolerance
l4_steps.input: Agency change request; contracted name-change policy
l4_steps.output: Updated PNR with revised passenger details; change fee invoice if applicable
l4_steps.kpi: Name changes processed within 4 hours of request; change fee collection rate 100%
l4_steps.pain_point: Post-ticketing name changes require ticket reissue via ATPCO exchange rules; agents unfamiliar with involuntary vs. voluntary reissue procedures generate MCO errors

l4_steps.name: Trigger final ticketing and collect balance payment
l4_steps.system: Amadeus Altéa Ticketing + SAP S/4HANA Finance (AR)
l4_steps.input: Complete PNL, T−7 days ticketing deadline trigger
l4_steps.output: Electronic tickets (ET) issued for all pax; balance collected via BSP/ARC
l4_steps.kpi: 100% ticket issuance by T−5 days; balance collection within 48 hours of ticketing
l4_steps.pain_point: Ticketing queue backlogs during peak season (summer, holidays) cause missed deadlines; auto-ticketing rules in Altéa are not universally configured for group bookings

l4_steps.name: Cancel non-ticketed seats and release to inventory
l4_steps.input: Outstanding unticketed seats at T−5 days
l4_steps.output: Excess seats returned to open inventory; cancellation fees invoiced
l4_steps.kpi: Seat release within 2 hours of deadline; revenue recovery via reopen sale ≥80% of released seats
l4_steps.pain_point: Last-minute seat release on high-load flights can trigger yield recalculation in NRM, causing overbooking alerts that require manual adjudication

l4_steps.name: Reconcile group revenue against sales forecast
l4_steps.system: Amadeus Revenue Management (NRM) + AWS Redshift (data warehouse)
l4_steps.input: Final ticketed revenue, group contract value, displacement cost model output
l4_steps.output: Group revenue performance report; variance to forecast logged
l4_steps.kpi: Revenue variance within ±5% of group forecast; report delivered within 3 business days of departure
l4_steps.pain_point: NRM revenue accounting and Altéa ticketing revenue figures frequently diverge due to currency rounding and BSP reporting timing differences; manual reconciliation required

l4_steps.name: Update group sales KPI dashboard and close record
l4_steps.input: Reconciled group revenue report, cancellation rate, change fee revenue
l4_steps.output: Closed group booking record; KPIs updated in group sales performance dashboard
l4_steps.kpi: Group conversion rate ≥65%; average group booking lead time ≥45 days; change-fee revenue tracked monthly
l4_steps.pain_point: Tableau dashboard relies on Altéa data extracts with T+1 latency; real-time group sales performance is not visible to management during the booking window
